title: The Rise of Agents and the Human Labor Market
abstract: arXiv:2611.27210v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We provide the first economy-wide and cross-AI model evidence on the effects of agentic AI on labor demand. We combine proprietary OpenRouter data covering about two quadrillion tokens of realized AI consumption (2 percent of global AI token consumption) across more than 400 AI models, including 1.1 quadrillion agentic tokens, with the full text of 34.8 million U.S. job postings for public firms from Lightcast. We compute our measure of firm-level exposure to aggregate agentic AI consumption (agentic beta) using the comovement of U.S. public firms' stock returns with realized weekly aggregate agentic AI token consumption. We find that a one-standard-deviation increase in a firm's exposure to agentic AI predicts 2.11 percent lower growth in job postings over the next six months and 3.20 percent over nine months. translated_title: 智能体的兴起与人类劳动力市场
translated_abstract: 我们提供了首个从全经济范围、跨AI模型视角研究智能体AI（agentic AI）对劳动力需求影响的经验证据。我们将专有的OpenRouter数据（涵盖约2千万亿token的已实现AI消费量，占全球AI token消费量的2%，涉及400多个AI模型，其中包括1.1千万亿个智能体token）与来自Lightcast的3480万条美国上市公司职位招聘信息全文相结合。我们通过美国上市公司股票收益率与已实现的每周智能体AI token总消费量之间的联动关系，构建了公司层面对智能体AI消费敞口的衡量指标（智能体beta）。我们发现，公司对智能体AI的敞口每增加一个标准差，预示着其未来六个月内职位发布量增长降低2.11%，九个月内降低3.20%。随后，我们基于Claude Code 2.0的发布开展了一项事件研究，该版本的发布显著扩展了AI智能体的能力……
tldr: 该论文首次提供了全经济范围、跨AI模型的经验证据，表明公司对智能体AI消费的敞口越高，其未来六至九个月的职位发布量增长显著越低。
en_tdlr: This paper provides the first economy-wide, cross-AI-model evidence that greater firm exposure to agentic AI consumption predicts significantly lower job posting growth over the following six to nine months.
